Rashi on Gittin 51a:10:1.hebrew: מאי פסקא - מאי דעתיה דתנא, וכי פסקא למילתיה, דסתם מאן דפסיק הכי, קנו מידו לבת אשתו ולא קנו לבתו:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:10:1.english: Why is it [a] categorical [ruling] - What is the Tanna's reasoning, and is his ruling [really] categorical, [such] that ordinarily, whoever stipulates thus, they performed an act of acquisition from him on behalf of his wife's daughter, and did not perform an acquisition on behalf of his [own] daughter?

Rashi on Gittin 51a:10:2.english: Who was not [alive] - for she had not yet been born:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:11:1.hebrew: מי לא עסקינן כו' - כלומר, ומי לא משמע נמי ממתני' כגון דהוו בנתיה בשעת קנין:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:11:1.english: Are we not dealing, etc. - That is to say, does the Mishnah not also imply [a case] such as where his daughters were [already alive] at the time of the acquisition:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:11:2.english: And what are the circumstances? - For example, where he divorced her after daughters were born to him from her:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:11:3.hebrew: ואהדרה - ופסקה עמו תנאים הללו, דהא מתני' סתמא תנן:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:11:3.english: And he took her back - and she stipulated these conditions with him, for the Mishnah teaches [its ruling] without qualification:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:13:1.english: But is [it] inferior - [This is] a rhetorical question:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:13:2.hebrew: כיון דבתנאי ב"ד קאכלה - והוא נמי קנו מידו, נותן לב להשלים חוקה:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:13:2.english: Since she eats based on a stipulation of the court - And [since] they also performed an act of acquisition from him, he pays attention to fulfill her allotment:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:13:3.hebrew: אימא צררי - של מעות, התפיסה במותו להיות בידה לזון מהם:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:13:3.english: Say [that] bundles - of money he entrusted to her upon his death, to be in her possession to be sustained from them:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:1.hebrew: אימתי - אמרו "אין מוציאין לאכילת פירות מנכסים משועבדים":
Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:1.english: When - [i.e., when] did they say, "One does not collect [payment] for the consumption of produce from encumbered property"?

Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:2.hebrew: בזמן שקדם מקחו - של לוקח שני זה, שהראשון שלקח שדה הגזולה בא לחזור עליו:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:2.english: When his purchase preceded - [that] of this second buyer, against whom the first [buyer], who purchased the stolen field, comes to seek recourse:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:3.hebrew: לשבחו של לוקח ראשון - שכשלקח זה השני מן המוכר, עדיין לא השביח הלוקח הראשון את הקרקע הגזולה:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:14:3.english: To the enhancement of the first buyer - for when this second [buyer] purchased [property] from the seller, the first buyer had not yet enhanced the stolen land:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:15:1.hebrew: אבל קדם שבחו של ראשון כו' - דמשהשביחה והכל יודעים שבאחריות מכרה לו, יצא כל אחריות הקרקע עם שבחו ופירותיה על נכסי הגזלן:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:15:1.english: But [if] the enhancements of the first [buyer] preceded, etc. - For once he enhanced it, and everyone knows that [the robber] sold it to him with a guarantee, the entire liability for the land — along with its enhancements and its produce — falls upon the robber's properties:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:15:2.english: Apparently, it is because it did not precede - and not because [the enhancements are not] fixed [in amount] and written [in a deed]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:16:1.hebrew: מפני תיקון העולם לפי שאין כתובין - ואם באת לטרוף לקוחות אף במלוה על פה, אין לך אדם לוקח שדה מחבירו, לפי שירא שמא יש עליו מלוה:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:16:1.english: For the betterment of the world, because they are not written - And if you come to seize [property from] purchasers even for an oral loan, no one will buy a field from his fellow, because he will fear lest there is a loan [owed] by him:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:17:1.hebrew: והלא אין קצובין - ובמה יש ללקוחות להזהר? ובלא תיקון העולם נמי אין הדין לטרוף:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:17:1.english: But aren't they unfixed [in amount] - And how are the purchasers to be careful? And even without [an enactment for] the betterment of the world, the law is not to seize [the property]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:18:1.hebrew: והלה אומר לא מצאתי אלא אחד נשבע - כדמפרש טעמא, דלא מנתחי מהדדי, והוה ליה טענתו של זה טענת ברי, אחרי שאחד מהם ביד זה, והרי הודה לו במקצת:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:18:1.english: And the other [person] says: "I found only one," [then] he takes an oath - As [the Gemara] explains the reason: because they [tied money pouches] do not become detached from one another, and [thus] this [claimant]'s claim is a definite claim, since one of them is in this [finder]'s possession, and behold, he has admitted to him part [of the claim].

Rashi on Gittin 51a:19:1.english: Oxen become detached from each other - and [therefore] it is an uncertain claim:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:1:1.hebrew: קצובין ואע"פ שאין כתובין - ואית ליה דמלוה על פה שהיא קצובה טרפה ממשעבדי:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:1:1.english: Fixed [in amount], even though they are not written - And he holds that a verbal loan that is fixed [in amount] collects from liened property:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:20:1.hebrew: שני שוורים קשורים מצאת לי, והלה אומר: מצאתי והחזרתי לך אחד מהן, הרי זה נשבע - שכן הוא שהחזיר לו האחד, דהויא ליה נמי טענה ודאית, ואף על פי שלא ראה כשמצאם, שהרי גם זה אומר כן, והוה ליה היאך מודה במקצת טענה ברורה. והך סיפא נמי ר' יצחק אמרה, ולא גרסינן בה "תניא נמי הכי":
Rashi on Gittin 51a:20:1.english: You found two tied oxen for me, and the other says, "I found [them] and returned one of them to you," he takes an oath - for it is indeed so that he returned the one to him, so that [the owner] also has a definite claim — even though he did not see [it] when [the finder] found them, for this [finder] also says so — and thus the other [finder] is admitting to part of a clear claim. And this latter clause was also stated by Rabbi Yitzchak, and we do not have the reading "It was also taught thus" in it:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:2:1.hebrew: ונטלה עישור נכסים - שזה משפט הבנות בשעת בגרות או נישואין, ליטול עישור נכסים בהכנסת פרנסת נדונייתן, לבד מה שניזונו מזונות עד אותה שעה:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:2:1.english: And she took one-tenth of the estate - For this is the entitlement of the daughters at the time of [their] reaching majority or marriage: to take one-tenth of the estate for the provision of their dowry, apart from [the fact] that they were provided with sustenance until that time:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:2:2.hebrew: ולא הספיקה שניה לגבות - פרנסתה, שלא ניסת:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:2:2.english: And the second [daughter] did not manage to collect - her dowry, because she had not [yet] married:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:2:3.english: Before the son died - and the entire inheritance fell to the two of them:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:1.hebrew: שניה ויתרה - איבדה עישור נכסים שלה, ולא אמרינן תיגבי עישור נכסים ברישא והשאר יחלקו בשוה, דטעמא דתקינו עישור נכסים כדי שתהא לבנות פרנסת נישואין, והא איכא טפי:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:1.english: The second [daughter] forfeited - she lost her one-tenth of the estate, and we do not say [that] she should collect one-tenth of the estate first and [that] they should divide the remainder equally; for the reason [the Sages] instituted one-tenth of the estate [is] so that the daughters will have a marriage dowry, and here there is more [than a tenth]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:2.hebrew: ואמר לו ר' חנינא - וכי מפני שקדמה זו, איבדה זו:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:2.english: And Rabbi Chanina said to him - Just because this [first] one preceded [her], did this [second] one lose [her share]?

Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:3.english: They said even more than this - that even if the brother sold the property:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:4.hebrew: מוציאין - מיד הלקוחות העישור לפרנסה, ואע"פ שאין מוציאין למזונות ממשעבדי:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:4.english: They extract - from the buyers the one-tenth [of the estate] for dowry, even though they do not extract [payment] for sustenance from encumbered [property]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:5.hebrew: ואת אמרת שניה ויתרה - מפני שלא הספיקה? והלא בשעבוד של אחרים, שהיא גדולה מזו, לא אמרו שתפסיד, ועכשיו שהן בפנינו, תפסיד? אלמא שמעינן לר' חנינא: קצובים טרפי ממשעבדי אף על פי שאין כתובין, כגון זו:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:3:5.english: And you say [the] second [daughter] forfeited [her dowry] - because she did not manage [to collect it]? Why, even regarding a lien on [property held by] others, which is a greater [case] than this, they did not say that she loses [it]; and now that they [the properties] are before us, should she lose [it]? Thus we learn regarding Rabbi Chanina [that] fixed [obligations] collect from encumbered [property] even though they are not written [in a document], such as this [case]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:4:1.english: It is fixed - [At] a tenth [of the estate]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:5:1.hebrew: דאית לה קלא - משעה שמת האב, הכל יודעין שהבת נוטלת עישור נכסים:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:5:1.english: [Since] it has publicity - From the time the father dies, everyone knows that the daughter takes a tenth of the estate:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:6:1.hebrew: מתו בנותיהן ניזונות כו' - הנושא את האשה ופסקה עמו לזון את בתה חמש שנים, וגירשה בתוך חמש שנים, ונשאת לאחר ופסקה עמו כמו כן — חייב לזונה חמש שנים; אחד זנה וא' נותן לה דמי מזונות. "מתו — בנותיהן ניזונות מנכסים בני חורין", כדקתני מתניתין: "אין מוציאין למזון האשה והבנות מנכסים משועבדים":
Rashi on Gittin 51a:6:1.english: If they died, their daughters are sustained, etc. - [This refers to the mishna regarding] one who marries a woman and she stipulates with him that he will sustain her daughter [from a previous marriage] for five years, and he divorced her within the five years, and she married another [man] and stipulated with him likewise — [each] is obligated to sustain her for five years: one sustains her [directly], and one gives her the monetary value of sustenance. [The mishna then states:] "If they died, their [own] daughters are sustained from unsold property," as our mishna teaches: "One may not extract [payment] for the sustenance of the wife and the daughters from encumbered property":

Rashi on Gittin 51a:7:1.english: And she - that daughter of his wife:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:7:2.hebrew: ניזונת מנכסים משועבדים כו' - אלמא, כיון דקייצי חמש שנים, אע"ג דלא כתיבא, גביא ממשעבדי כר' חנינא, וקשיא לעולא:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:7:2.english: [She] is sustained from liened property, etc. - Thus, since five years are fixed, even though [the obligation] is not written, she collects from liened [property], in accordance with [the view of] Rabbi Chanina, and it is a difficulty for Ulla:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:8:1.english: Where they acquired from his hand - and an unspecified act of acquisition stands to be written [in a document]:

Rashi on Gittin 51a:9:1.hebrew: אי הכי בנות נמי - דהויא לה מיניה, ליתזנו ממשעבדי, הואיל ובקנו מידו קא מיירי:
Rashi on Gittin 51a:9:1.english: If so, [his] daughters as well - whom she had from him, should be sustained from encumbered [property], since [the Mishnah] is speaking of [a case] where they acquired [this right] from his hand:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:13:1.hebrew: אימר צררי אתפסה - דוקא לגבי משועבדים חיישינן, אבל גבי בני חרי לא, דאמרינן בפרק שני דייני גזירות (כתובות קז:): צררי לקטנה לא מתפיס. וצריך עיון, דלענין משעבדי חיישינן במזונות טפי לצררי מבכתובה, דכתובה נפרעת בשבועה מנכסים משועבדים, ומזונות לא גבי כלל אפילו בשבועה; ולענין בני חרי הוי איפכא, דלענין מזונות גבי בלא שבועה, ולכתובה בעי שבועה, כדתנן בפ' שני דייני גזירות (כתובות דף קד:): מי שהלך למדינת הים ואשתו תובעת מזונות, חנן אומר: תשבע בסוף ולא תשבע בתחילה:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:13:1.english: Say [that] he entrusted bundles [of money] to her - Specifically with respect to encumbered [property] we are concerned [about this], but with respect to unencumbered [property] we are not, as we say in the chapter [entitled] Shenei Dayyanei Gezeirot (Ketubot 107b): One does not entrust bundles [of money] to a minor. And this requires further study, for with respect to encumbered [property], we are more concerned about bundles [of money] regarding sustenance than regarding a ketubah, since a ketubah is collected with an oath from encumbered property, whereas sustenance is not collected at all [from encumbered property], even with an oath; whereas with respect to unencumbered [property] it is the opposite, for regarding sustenance she collects without an oath, whereas for a ketubah she requires an oath, as we learned in the Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Shenei Dayyanei Gezeirot (Ketubot 104b): One who went overseas and his wife demands sustenance, Ḥanan says: She takes an oath at the end, and she does not take an oath at the beginning:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:15:1.hebrew: אלמא משום דלא קדים הוא - פי' בקונטרס: ולאו משום דקצובין וכתובין. וק', דא"כ כי משני "תנאי היא", לא הוי רבי נתן לא כמר ולא כמר! ונראה דלעולא פריך דוקא, ולמפשט נמי דרבי חנינא: קצובין אע"פ שאין כתובין; דבזמן שקדם שבחו של ראשון, היינו קצובין ואין כתובין, דכתיבה לא מהניא אע"ג שכבר בא השבח, כיון דבשעת הכתיבה אכתי לא הוה:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:15:1.english: Apparently, because it did not precede - Rashi explained: "and not because they are fixed and written." And this is difficult: for if so, when [the Gemara] answers, "It is [a dispute between] tannaim," Rabbi Natan would not accord with either this one or that one! Rather, it appears that [the Gemara] raises the objection specifically against Ulla, and also to resolve [the view] of Rabbi Ḥanina: [that they must be] fixed, even though they are not written; for when the enhancements of the first [buyer] preceded [the second buyer's purchase], that is [a case of] fixed [amounts] that are not written, since writing is not effective even though the enhancement has already come [into existence], because at the time of the writing [of the deed] it did not yet exist:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:17:1.hebrew: וכי מה תקון העולם יש בזה והלא אין קצובין - פי' בקונטרס: ומן הדין בלא תיקון העולם אין לגבות ממשעבדי, כיון דאין קצובין. וקשה, דהא ר' חנינא דאמר "לפי שאין קצובין", קאי לפרושי "מפני תיקון העולם" דמתני'. לכך נראה דה"פ: קא תלית טעמא "מפני תיקון העולם" בכתיבה — מה תיקון העולם יש בזה? דאפילו הוו כתובין לא גבי ממשעבדי, דאין תיקון העולם תלוי בכתיבה, אלא בקציבה:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:17:1.english: And what betterment of the world is there in this? But aren't they not fixed? - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained: By [strict] law, even without [the enactment for] the betterment of the world, one does not collect from liened property, since they are not fixed. But [this] is difficult, for Rabbi Ḥanina, who said "because they are not fixed," comes to explain "for the betterment of the world" of our Mishnah! Therefore, it appears that this is its meaning: [Since] you hang the reason "for the betterment of the world" on [their being] written — what betterment of the world is there in this? For even if they were written, one would not collect from liened property, since the betterment of the world does not depend on [their being] written, but rather on [their being] fixed:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:19:1.hebrew: כיסין לא מינתחי מהדדי - ואפילו רבי (מאיר) בפ"ק דביצה (דף י:) דאמר גבי כיסין "זימנין דמיתעכל קיטרייהו", היינו משום דאיכא הוכחא שהניח מאתים ולא מצא אלא מנה; אבל הכא, מי יימר דלא מצא אלא אחד:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:19:1.english: Pouches do not become detached from each other - And even [according to] Rabbi (Meir) in the first chapter of Beitzah (10b), who says regarding pouches, "Sometimes their knots disintegrate," that is because there is proof, as he placed two hundred [zuz] and found only a maneh; but here, who says that he found only one?

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:1:1.hebrew: או דילמא קצובין אע"פ שאין כתובין - פי' בקונטרס, ואית ליה דמלוה על פה גובה ממשעבדי. ואין נראה, דבהדיא תנן בפרק גט פשוט (ב"ב דף קעה.) דגובה מנכסים בני חורין! ומפרש ר"ת דהכא לא איירי במלוה, אלא בשאר מילי דקצבה, כגון פסק לזון את בתה חמש שנים; דדוקא במלוה על פה לא גבי ממשעבדי, משום דמאן דיזיף בצנעא יזיף, אבל שאר מילי הוו כמכר, דאמרי' (ב"ב דף מא:): המוכר שדהו בעדים גובה מנכסים משועבדים, דמאן דמזבן בפרהסיא מזבן:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:1:1.english: Or perhaps [it suffices that they be] fixed, even though they are not written - Rashi explained [this], and he holds that an oral loan may be collected from liened property. But [this] does not seem [correct], for we explicitly learned in a Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Get Pashut (Bava Batra 175a) that it may [only] be collected from unencumbered property! Rather, Rabbeinu Tam explains that here [the Gemara] is not speaking of a loan, but of other fixed obligations, such as [where one] undertook to support her daughter for five years; for specifically in [the case of] an oral loan one does not collect from liened property, because whoever borrows, borrows in secret, but other matters are like a sale, regarding which we say (Bava Batra 41b): One who sells his field before witnesses may collect from liened property, because whoever sells, sells publicly:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:20:1.hebrew: תניא נמי הכי - פי' בקונטרס דל"ג תנ"ה, והך סיפא נמי ר' יצחק אמרה, וגרס בסיפא דהך: "שני שוורים קשורים מצאת לי", והלה אומר "מצאתי והחזרתי לך אחד מהם" — הרי זה נשבע. וקשה: דליהמניה במגו, דאי בעי אמר "לא מצאתי אלא אחד"! ועוד: לפי המסקנא, ר' יצחק דאמר כמאן? אלא הכי גרסינן: "תניא נמי הכי: 'שני שוורים מצאת לי', והלה אומר 'לא מצאתי אלא אחד' — אינו נשבע; 'שני כיסין קשורין מצאת לי', והלה אומר 'מצאתי לך והחזרתי לך אחד מהן' — הרי זה נשבע." וה"ה דאם אמר "לא מצאתי אלא אחד" דנשבע, מדלא מיפטר כי אמר "החזרתי לך אחד מהן" במיגו, והיינו כר' יצחק. והא דנקט "החזרתי לך אחד מהן" בברייתא, ולא נקט "ולא מצאתי אלא אחד", לרבותא נקט, דלא מפטר במיגו דאי בעי הוה טעין טענה מעלייתא "לא מצאתי אלא אחד"; קמ"ל דאערומי קא מערים, דסבר: אי אמינא "לא מצאתי אלא אחד" בעינן אישתבועי, אימא "החזרתי" ולא בעינא אישתבועי. דכי האי גוונא אמרינן בפ"ק דבבא מציעא (דף ד:), דאע"ג דמסייעא ליה ברייתא, פריך ליה ממתני', דהיכי שביק מתני' מקמי ברייתא, ומשני: הוא דאמר כר"א בן יעקב, שהוא קב ונקי; ולבסוף דלא קאי, יאמר על כרחו: אנא דאמרי כברייתא, לפיכך לא קאמר תיובתא:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:20:1.english: It was also taught thus - Rashi explained that we do not read "It was also taught thus," and that this latter clause too was stated by Rabbi Yitzḥak; and [Rashi] reads in the latter clause of this [statement]: "You found two tied oxen belonging to me," and the other says, "I found [them] and returned one of them to you" — he takes an oath. And this is difficult: let us believe him with a migo, since if he wanted, he could have said, "I only found one"! And furthermore: according to the conclusion [of the Gemara], in accordance with whom did Rabbi Yitzḥak state [his ruling]? Rather, this is how we read [the Gemara]: "It was also taught thus: '[If one says,] "You found two oxen belonging to me," and the other says, "I only found one" — he does not take an oath. [If one says,] "You found two tied pouches belonging to me," and the other says, "I found [them] for you and returned one of them to you" — he takes an oath.'" And the same applies if he said, "I only found one," that he takes an oath — [as is evident] from the fact that he is not exempt when he says, "I returned one of them to you," by means of a migo — and this is in accordance with Rabbi Yitzḥak. And the reason [the baraita] stated "I returned one of them to you" in the baraita, and did not state "I only found one," is that it stated [the more novel case] to teach a greater novelty: that he is not exempt by means of a migo that if he wanted, he could have pleaded a better plea, [namely,] "I only found one." [Rather,] it teaches us that he is acting deceitfully, for he thinks: "If I say, 'I only found one,' I will have to take an oath; [so] I will say, 'I returned [one],' and I will not have to take an oath." For in a similar manner we say in the first chapter of Bava Metzia (4b): that even though a baraita supports him, [the Gemara] raises an objection against him from the Mishnah — [asking] how he could abandon the Mishnah in favor of a baraita — and [the Gemara] answers: He stated [his ruling] in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov, whose [teaching] is kav venaki [measured and pure]; and in the end, when [that answer] does not hold up, he will perforce say, "I stated [my ruling] in accordance with the baraita," [and] therefore [the Gemara] does not say tiyuvta [a refutation]:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:3:1.hebrew: אמר ר' חנינא גדולה מזו כו' - למאי דמסיק בפרק מציאת האשה (כתובות דף סט.) דרבי יוחנן קיבלה מרבי (חנינא), הוה מצי למיפרך השתא, דבעי למידק דקצובין לחודיה מהני, ארבי יוחנן דאמר לעיל "לפי שאין כתובין"; ומיהו התם דחויא בעלמא הוא, ובמסקנא דהכא ניחא:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:3:1.english: Rabbi Ḥanina said: More than this, etc. - According to what [the Gemara] concludes in the chapter [entitled] Metzi'at HaIsha (Ketubot 69a) that Rabbi Yoḥanan accepted it from Rabbi (Ḥanina), [the Gemara] could have raised an objection now — when it seeks to infer that fixed [amounts] alone are effective — against Rabbi Yoḥanan, who said above, "because they are not written"; however, there it is merely a deflection, and according to the conclusion here it is resolved:

Tosafot on Gittin 51a:8:1.hebrew: בשקנו מידו - פי' בקונטרס דהוו ככתובין, דסתם קנין לכתיבה עומד. וקשה, דא"כ, אמאי פריך "אי הכי בנות נמי"? הא לא מהני כתיבה דבנות כדאמר לעיל! לכך נראה דקנין אלים טפי מכתיבה, לכך פריך "בנות נמי": נהי דכתיבה לא מהני, קנין ליתהני:
Tosafot on Gittin 51a:8:1.english: Where they acquired from his hand - Rashi explained that they are as if written, because an ordinary act of acquisition [kinyan] stands to be written. And this is difficult: if so, why does [the Gemara] ask, "If so, [what about] daughters as well?" Surely writing is not effective for daughters, as [the Gemara] said above! Therefore, it appears that an act of acquisition is stronger than writing; therefore [the Gemara] asks, "[What about] daughters as well? Granted that writing is not effective, let an act of acquisition be effective!":
